Vaibhav Sooryavanshi Becomes Youngest Indian Cricketer, England Wins T20I

Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi made his international cricket debut for India in a T20 match against England, becoming the country's youngest player to do so and surpassing Sachin Tendulkar's debut age record. Despite his historic milestone and a brief cameo, England secured a victory in the match, with player Jacob Bethell contributing significantly to their win. The coverage highlights both Sooryavanshi's record-breaking achievement and the match's outcome.
